Minute counters have no stated expiry or cleanup, so old window data accumulates indefinitely across up to 1 crore users. Consider expiring counter entries after their minute ends to bound storage.

Partition/primary key is message_id, but reads look up chat_id. A chat lookup cannot go to one partition and cannot return messages in recency order, so it fans out and sorts across the store. Partition/sort by chat first so one chat's messages live together in order.
